property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, the reference contract always returns true when all low-level calls to the callee do not revert (even if they return false), whereas the mutant returns false as soon as any low-level call reports success; the mutant thus can produce a different boolean return for some inputs where a callee returns success without reverting.
change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately if any internal call succeeds (invert success check), causing return value to differ when calls succeed but not revert.
